name: virtualization_mcp
description: VirtualBox & Hyper-V VM management, Docker sandbox execution, Windows Sandbox bringup, snapshots, networking, storage, and fleet install testing via FastMCP 3.4
long_description: Virtualization MCP is a production-ready FastMCP 3.4 server providing comprehensive VM management (VirtualBox + Hyper-V), Docker sandbox environments (ephemeral and stateful), Windows Sandbox bringup, snapshot management, networking, storage, system diagnostics, ISO download pipeline, and fleet app install testing. 8 portmanteau tools with 60+ operations.

prompts.name: create_vm_guided
prompts.description: Get guided help for creating a virtual machine based on your use case
prompts.text: I need help creating a virtual machine for my use case. Recommend appropriate configuration (memory, CPU, disk, network) and guide me through the setup process.

prompts.name: troubleshoot_vm
prompts.description: Get help diagnosing and fixing virtual machine issues
prompts.text: I need help diagnosing a virtual machine issue. Walk through diagnosis step by step and provide troubleshooting guidance.

prompts.name: setup_network
prompts.description: Get guidance on network configuration for your use case
prompts.text: I need help configuring virtual networking. Explain the configuration options and guide me through the setup process.

prompts.name: snapshot_best_practices
prompts.description: Get recommendations for snapshot management strategy
prompts.text: I need snapshot management recommendations: when to create snapshots, naming conventions, and cleanup strategy.

prompts.name: multi_vm_deployment
prompts.description: Get guidance for deploying multi-VM architectures
prompts.text: I need guidance deploying a multi-VM architecture: VM configuration, network topology, and step-by-step deployment.
